      public void setCurrentTheme(com.qut.cab302_project_pomodora.config.Theme theme)
      Sets the current theme preference. Does not automatically update existing scenes. Call applyTheme or applyCurrentTheme on specific scenes to see the change.

      theme - The theme to set as current.
